affected_subject.reason: Identifies injectAndCall on the router contract and its intended delegatecall-only design.

trigger_or_action.reason: Concrete trigger: anyone calls injectAndCall directly on the router, causing it to act as caller and read router balance.

direct_effect.reason: Immediate effect: router balance is read and injected into arbitrary target calls, enabling drain of router ETH/ERC20.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Expected delegatecall-only wallet-balance isolation vs actual direct-call router-balance misuse establishes authorization/state-transition safety relation.

summary: Report provides affected function, concrete direct-call trigger, immediate router-balance misuse/drain effect, and expected-vs-actual isolation violation, sufficient to derive P/I/V.
